title: Fed up with coupon gymnastics
content:
I’ve been a SHEIN customer for years and genuinely love the range, styles and prices. I’ve found some of my favourite outfits on here, and the variety means I can buy everything from conference and work wear to holiday, party and more alternative styles.
However, I really wish SHEIN would rethink the coupon and discount system. I’d much rather see the actual price I am going to pay when I add an item to my basket even if that advertised price is slightly higher.
Too often an item appears to be a bargain, but then the final price changes dramatically depending on coupons, promotions, minimum spends and checkout conditions. It can feel frustrating when an item that looked one price effectively doubles or triples once those discounts aren’t available or don’t apply.
For the first time ever today, I have ended up placing an order with TEMU instead. Not because I preferred the clothing, but because the price I saw when I added items to my basket was the price that I paid at the checkout. There were no surprises and no complicated coupon calculations to work out.
As a customer, I’d rather see a higher, but honest price than a lower headline price that changes depending on which promotions happen to apply. Transparency builds trust,  and trust keeps customers coming back.
I still love the clothing, the choice and the ability to find styles that suit my personality.
Some of my favourite outfits have come from SHEIN and I would much rather continue to shop with you than elsewhere. Please keep the fashion but make the pricing simpler and more transparent.

title: Ich liebs
content:
Ich bestelle mittlerweile schon seit längerer Zeit bei SHEIN und bin jedes Mal aufs Neue positiv überrascht. Die Auswahl an Kleidung, Accessoires und Schuhen ist wirklich unglaublich groß – egal ob man etwas Elegantes, Alltagstaugliches oder die neuesten Trends sucht, man findet einfach immer etwas Passendes. Besonders beeindruckend finde ich, wie oft neue Kollektionen erscheinen und wie modern die Designs sind.
Was mich persönlich am meisten überzeugt, ist das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Natürlich erwartet man bei diesen Preisen keine Luxusmarke, aber viele Artikel haben mich qualitativ wirklich überrascht. Die Stoffe fühlen sich angenehm an, die Kleidung sitzt oft besser als erwartet und die Produkte entsprechen in den meisten Fällen genau den Bildern und Beschreibungen. Mit den Bewertungen und Kundenfotos kann man außerdem sehr gut einschätzen, wie die Sachen in echt aussehen und welche Größe man wählen sollte – das macht das Einkaufen deutlich einfacher.
Auch der Bestellprozess ist super unkompliziert. Die App und die Website sind übersichtlich gestaltet, man findet schnell, was man sucht, und die vielen Filter helfen enorm dabei, gezielt nach bestimmten Styles oder Größen zu suchen. Die Lieferung war bei meinen Bestellungen meistens schneller als angegeben und alles kam ordentlich verpackt an. Besonders praktisch finde ich auch die regelmäßigen Rabattaktionen und Gutscheine, wodurch man oft richtig gute Angebote bekommt. Ein weiterer Pluspunkt ist die Vielfalt: Bei SHEIN gibt es wirklich Mode für jeden Geschmack und jede Figur. Von Basics bis hin zu ausgefallenen Trendteilen ist alles dabei. Ich habe dort schon Kleidung für den Alltag, besondere Anlässe, Sport und sogar Deko bestellt und war insgesamt sehr zufrieden. Für mich ist SHEIN eine der besten Möglichkeiten, günstig und gleichzeitig stylisch einzukaufen. Wer gerne neue Trends ausprobiert, ohne ein Vermögen auszugeben, ist dort definitiv richtig. Ich werde auf jeden Fall weiterhin dort bestellen und kann es wirklich empfehlen.

title: It’s an okay app…
content: I’ve had SHEIN for about 6 months now. I’ve ordered household items, toys, clothes, etc. Some of the items have had chemical smells, ripped or broken, or died quickly. My biggest issue with SHEIN is that they promise you “free gifts” that you don’t receive because they still make you pay for something or make you do a thousand steps, only to still NOT receive the gifts. For example the “Money Tree” on the app tells you that you and an X amount of users will split FREE gifts after you invite friends to join the app. Shein tells me I need one invite, so I invite my friend. He successfully redeems his gifts, but then Shein tells me I’m “almost there”, and I would need another invite (they have them set up like points). Did that…then all of a sudden I need one final invite, now my invites won’t work, and my friends can’t sign up to accept it. They throw loopholes anywhere they can. “Puppy Keep” on the app lets you feed a virtual dog to get one free gift but that takes literal weeks, and they make it go slower at the last few percent (you’ll see what I’m talking about once you play it). With the coupons, you don’t really win a $100, $200, etc, they break it down to smaller coupons equaling the value ($5, $10, etc (the higher you spend, the higher the higher the coupon, but you can only use one and they only apply to a couple of items in your cart, not everything)). Sometimes the clothes are super cute, and have great quality though. In all, it’s an okay app.

Geburtstagsdeko um Vielfaches günstiger als bei anderen Versandriesen. Hab es schon meiner Schwester weiterempfohlen und kann es wirklich jedem empfehlen.
Einfach mal probieren, vielleicht erst für einen Kleinen Betrag, dann hat man sich selber seine Meinung gebildet. Liebe Grüße

Ich bestelle seit dem sehr regelmäßig ! Also traut euch 🙋🏻‍♀️

title: Amazing but check reviews
content:
I’ve found shein to be a great online shopping app, it’s the only one I use and I’ve downloaded tons. But I’d recommend looking at reviews at the items and double checking descriptions of clothing etc to check if it’s to your standard, eg; stretchy or thick fabric etc. if not you may be disappointed by your purchase. You can return most items such as clothing but not makeup and some jewellery obviously. Online payments which is good as it includes clear pay for uk residents of ur not willing to pay in full. And it’s so easy to track your parcels, as I’m writing this mine is in transit. Some deliveries do take a few days such as a week or two. But I’ve found small purchases come as quick as 5 days. It has everything you could wish for including points which u can log into the app daily to get them or enter clothing challenges etc to take money off your final purchase, coupons, TONS of them and so much more!
Overall I love this app and definitely recommend

title: I wanna give five stars
content: I love so many things about SHEIN. I like to pronounce it, Shine! They always have my size which is usually hard to find. You can filter for better material quality if you’re like me and prefer/need natural fibres. The shipping and returns aren’t scammy like lots of other international companies. I find that if you follow their descriptions everything is generally spot on size wise, and it’s affordable for very poor people like me. Alas, I can’t give a full five bc of the unfair labour practices that keep being mentioned online. I also follow some tiktok creators who have had their designs stolen from SHEIN which isn’t cool. There could be more care for the environment. The shipping is pretty slow but tbh if it were faster in this current climate it’d only drive up the prices so I’m cool with planning ahead a bit. Lots to love and trust about SHEIN and they aren’t worse ethically than other high street brands but are cheaper and have my size so they beat the competition in many ways but definitely have some serious room for improvement. Trustworthy for actually getting what you ordered and being able to return it without much hassle which is pretty major.

title: Favourite shopping app
content: Such a huge selection of stunning dresses & lovely things. Easiest shopping site to navigate on the whole net. Has a better & more efficient built in search engine than Google. Although everything is made in China, the cut is not for Oriental women. There’s breathing room & flexibility in every garment. Beautiful, cool, comfortable fabrics, well tailored & always a flattering cut. So affordable I’ve bought my favourite dresses in many colours & bought 2 of each of my favourite colours in each range as I wear their summer dresses everyday & have tons of their black & white suit style dresses which look so expensive & smart so as to make you feel confident when walking around posh department stores & you get treated with respect by their staff (as we know, some posh department stores judge us on how we look & discriminate against us if we don’t look the part.) Such a huge selection. I’ve bought tons of gorgeous dresses & loads of stunning belts. I’m probably gonna buy some of their crystals next time I do a big shop. Just wish their crystal range was wider & slightly cheaper as the same crystals are half the price on Alliexpress, so are some higher quality, bigger crystals. Most stuff arrives fast so they obviously have warehouses in U.K. You don’t have to wait for them to ship it from China like other All Chinese made sites. It’s my favourite place to buy dresses but there are cheaper sources for the exact same homeware & same cosmetic related products, the latter of which I wouldn’t buy as ALL Chinese cosmetics are tested on animals & in Labs with No Animal Welfare rules, checks, standards or limits.

title: Treasures to be found
content:
I feel a bit like a pirate digging up gold on the app sometimes. The stuff I’ve bought for my very spoilt cat has been amazing and compares well to expensive items found elsewhere. I’ve also found gems for me too.
Quality of clothing is hit and miss but the return process is easy so it’s not a problem. I’ve found some stunning dresses on here for around £20 that would be £100plus elsewhere. They do some really cool and quirky home accessories too.
I am aware that a lot of the clothes are not from sustainable processes but unfortunately I am not in a financial position to be 100% ethical when shipping. However, there are some items that mention sustainability.
I recommend reading the reviews, the customers are your friend, the photos and feedback are really helpful when making choices and you get discounts for providing them, regardless of what you say so people are very honest.

title: Never looked back
content:
I admit I was a little hesitant to order anything at first, I thought it would be poor quality and the wait times horrendous. Not so. Not so at alllllll.

Firstly once I decided to order - I thought I’d start small - impossible! There’s so much gorgeous stuff! Quite a large order with free express delivery (I still thought it would take ages) and also 25% off due to order size. The amount of compliments I have had on my clothes have been ridiculous, including the style and quality and I love them. I had lost some confidence in myself and my appearance so the order was a wardrobe overhaul. I have never looked back. The delivery came in 2, first one arrived within days and the second just after a week. I didn’t return a single item (though I have been assured by my 18yr old daughter that returns are super simple).

Today I have ordered some things for my mother in law, and also my 9yr old daughter (as well as some more things for me! Haha) I am so excited to receive my order. Again free express shipping and also 25% discount. If you get to the pay screen and it seems too much, double check and press cancel - you may not have applied your discount. It asks if you want it all back in your basket, say yes, go back through checkout and apply any discount codes you are eligible for. Simples.

ENJOY!

title: Wirklich tolle Sachen!
content: Man muss sich aber die Rezensionen anschauen, am besten mit Bildern. Meist ist’s aber genau wie beschrieben und wie auf dem Bild. Bei Rechnung wurde diese oder die zurück gesendeten Artikel schon bei Aufgabe des Paketes sofort  erstattet  oder storniert. Nun ja summa summarum ist’s aber ein toller online Shop, Versand dauert meist 12-18 Tage (Ware kommt ja auch aus China). Rücksendung ist problemlos und kostenlos (eine kostenlose Rücksendung pro Bestellung). Die Größen stimmen auch oft überein (immer die Bewertungen zu den Artikeln lesen).

title: Good App Fun inexpensive products!
content: I really like SHIEN. The app works greats. It’s basically flawless. Easy to use, fun to use, and never any problems. The products on here so diverse. They are also very inexpensive. You get what you pay for so I do recommend really reading the ratings and reviews of products, as well as the products dimensions, sizes (the sizes are Asian sizes so run smaller than US), and descriptions. Just Beware of shipping times with them always. It’s mostly from China so It can take awhile to get your package, but the app does provide good tracking and from my experiences very good, efficient customer service with any issues or questions I have had. I love that SHIEN has a rewards program where you can earn daily points by checking in, and also by reviewing the products you order. It adds up if you stay on top of checking and write reviews. The coupons the app provides as well as the sales are really good too! I would recommend this app and SHEIN products to almost anyone.

content:
I live in Greece and it is really difficult getting stuff from the U.K. now. Some things take three months to reach me if sent by standard mail.

I have just placed an order for some homeware (towels, sheets and cushions etc) so will have to see what these are like.

content:
お値段が安く多彩なバリエーション。洋服だけでなく小物やアクセサリーまで激安で売られていてかなりいいアプリ。
けれど、他の方が言っているように私もそうだったのですが買ったあとが酷いです。
商品はほぼ全て海外から届くので時間がかかるのは仕方ないのですが、必ずと言っていいほど日にち通りには来ません。速達便でも必ず3日4日ズレてくるので速達便を使うのはおすすめできません。

あと1週間待って届かないようなら消費者センターにお問い合わせするつもりです。
悪い点ばかりあげましたが、しっかり届けばめちゃくちゃいいアプリです。少なからずしっかり届いた方もいます。今から購入を考えてる方は皆さんのレビューを見て、今1度よく考えてから利用して欲しいです。

title: Fantastic app and online store
content:

The items itself is a bit touch and go although 98%of the item I’ve purchased have been as advertised (the key is to read the reviews) and great quality but you have got to be wary on sizes… be sure to read enough reviews on items to way up the size you need to order. Orders usually end up coming in separate deliveries also due to being stored in separate warehouses but again always arrives in the time given.

title: 신중하게 결정하기
content:
미국앱인줄 알았더니 중국통한 쇼핑몰
배송지는 한국인대 중국에서 한달넘게 물건 안옴
메일로 문의하면 나라에 도착안했다고
오래 기다리면 환불하라고함
그러나 환불정책물어보면 개인사이트에 환불된다고함..뭔말이니!!  번역기쓰는건 알지만 내용이해를 못함!!
그리고 환불해달라고하면 조금더 기다려보라고 함
일단은 내가 6월 중순까지는 기다리는데
안오면 신고할꺼임!!
결재한지 두달째!!  사기일 가능성을 배제할수 없으니
스스로 잘 판단하고 결정하시길...
블로그 후기들보면 개인피드도 있지만 개인피드를 빙자한 후기지원받은 블로거들 있는듯!!
물건을 보내든 환불을 해주든!!  뭔가의 대책이 필요함...  피해자들이 많이 나와야 스토어에서 앱을 다운 받는 또다른 피해자들이 없게 해야할거같아서
솔직하고 정리없이 올림!!!

title: Cheap and cheerful!
content: I’ve been using Shein for years now and I’ve only ever had a few issues (my own fault) due to clothing sizes. I don’t understand why shein gets such bad publicity when all you need is literally here! People like to buy clothing with the wrong size and blame shein but You can fill out a size chart and get clothes tailored to your own size. Everything comes as pictured; so what you see is what you get! You can earn points by checking in everyday and it can be used as a discount not to mention you get given weekly discount codes which is amazing! Being from the uk your package will take at least a week to come but you can pay extra for faster shipping. Sometimes you can get some of your items in the uk warehouse but you can’t chose it usually comes from the China one. Overall it is great! Don’t knock it till you try it! A lot of the stuff on there is cheap as hell and comes exactly as pictured. Give it a go :)

author: SMILESKXAWNG

title: My review
content:
I came across this app from an old friend, I asked her where her outfit was from and she was like, ‘shein of course!’  Wondering why I’d never heard or come across this app, I asked my mum if she’d ever heard of it and she told me she’s actually done quite a few orders from here, all good quality and comfortable fit. I decided to download it, even though I don’t normally order offline however when COVID-19 hit, I decided to have a little go at online shopping. After about 3 hours of scrolling through and adding items to my basket on shein, I realised I had over 200 items!!
It became my go-to shopping app as it’s not only clothes they have but accessories such as handbags, earrings, necklaces, phone cases, hats, rings, pop it’s and more.
I’ve done about 7 orders off Shein and all of my items have been extraordinary, comfortable fits, cute outfits, good prices, amazing quality and always true to size!
I mean, what more could you want?
If I’m going to be honest, it’s become a bit of an addictive app which I don’t see as a bad thing.
The only thing I will say is that it takes at least maybe a week and a half to arrive and if you have a big order it may be split into different packages so they will come at different times but in my case that’s only ever happened once and it was a Tuesday then a Thursday so it wasn’t that far apart.
I’d recommend shein for anyone. It’s so amazing and I’m absolutely in love with this app! 🤪😝

title: Positiv überrascht
content: Ich war Anfangs skeptisch, bei Shein zu bestellen. Allerdings muss ich sagen, ich bin echt positiv überrascht und begeistert. Die Kleidung hat dieselbe Qualität wie von H&M, Bershka, Pull&bear, Zara usw. wenn nicht sogar teilweise besser. Ich habe ein Oberteil von h&m für 20€ gekauft und genau dasselbe bei shein für 5€. Das von shein hat einen viel dickeren und qualitativ hochwertigeren Stoff. Der Versand ist schnell, weiß aber nicht ob es immer so ist. Bis jetzt habe ich zwei mal bei Shein bestellt und beide Male hat es unter 5 Tage gedauert bis das Paket bei mir angekommen ist. Der Kundenservice ist der Hammer!!!!! Ich habe ein Bauchnabelpiercing bestellt, dort ist leider ein kleiner Stein abgegangen, ich habe den Kundenservice angeschrieben und mir wurde das komplette Geld erstattet und ich durfte das Piercing behalten (welches man trotzdem noch gut tragen konnte) ich werde jetzt immer wieder bei Shein bestellen, einfach weil ich es nicht einsehe bei Zara für ein Oberteil 25€ auszugeben, wo ich bei Shein fast dasselbe mit derselben quali für 5-10€ bekomme. Außerdem gibt es immer wieder gute Shein Rabattcodes, wo man sogar NOCH MEHR sparen kann. Wirklich nur zu empfehlen!!! Ich habe nur einen Verbesserungsvorschlag, sucht euch einen besseren Übersetzer🤣 die App ist super zu bedienen allerdings lacht man sich manchmal kaputt, weil das Deutsch nicht das Beste ist. Man versteht es zwar, es ist aber lustig. Typische Google-Übersetzer Fails. Das ist aber das einzige negative, was ich über Shein zu sagen habe.

title: 너무~ 좋아
content:
장점
1. 가격이 개쌈 치마 싼건 삼천원정도 함 상의도 진짜 쌈
2. 가격에 비해 질도 나쁘지 않음 (수영복 질이 되게 좋다고 들음 but 가방은 트위드재질인거 제발 사지마)
3. 한국어 지원되고 배송절차도 어렵지않음 뭐 무슨번호이런거 필요없음
4. 우리나라 쇼핑몰처럼 보정 떡칠하고 분위기빨로 먹지 않기 때문에 옷자체를 볼수있음
5. 배송받고 망해도 애들가격이 싸기 때문에 화많이 안남 진짜 대부분 오천원대

단점
1. 배송이 느림 (근데 이건 해외라 어쩔수 없는듯 케바케지만 빠르면 8일 정도 늦으면 한달 넘게도 옴)
2. 가성비 갑이긴 한데 가아끔씩 싼값하는거 걸릴수도 (나같은 경우는 트위드 가방..)
3. 외쿡 스타일이어서 예쁜 청바지나 귀염하늘? 한것들 많이 없음 대부분 섹시 시크
4. 아직 안해봤지만 환불개어렵대

title: ABSOLUTELY LOVE
content:
I came across this on an advert on Snapchat, and I have bought so much stuff! I love it all! I have never found a reason to complain and all the clothing is suited specifically to what I have bought or favourited. It’s such a good app, the clothes mostly arrive fast and are of a good size. Once I had an item of clothing which didn’t fit, so I returned it and found an easy, helpful return system which gave me a full refund, I sent back my clothes and bought the exact same ones in a smaller size and it was great! All the customer reviews are helpful and honest, they come from real people not fake people paid to say positive false information which I love. All the trends are current and I find myself filling my basket to £££ and then trying to buy them one by one 🤣 Before this app, my wardrobe was fine but a bit bland and ordinary, and since then I feel like an ABSOLUTE QUEEN getting ready in the morning. My one complaint is that I can’t choose between the millions of outfits to buy and wear! Thanks so much for keeping up with trends and making my fashion life soooo much better xx
😍❤️💫

title: Einfach nur Wow!
content: Ich bin schon länger Kundin bei Shein und möchte ehrlich mal einen Lob aussprechen! Um die Produkte kann man sich streiten, ja. Nicht alles hat eine gute Qualität aber dafür gibt es die Kundenmeinungen die sehr weiterhelfen! Preise sind niedrig, es gibt immer tolle Sales, Rabatte, man kann Punkte sammeln und echt hohen Preis-Nachlass erwerben. Versand geht immer schnell und ist zuverlässig. Man kann die Sendungen nachverfolgen und die App ist insgesamt sehr übersichtlich! Aber wo ich echt am meisten begeistert bin, ist das Kundenservice. Man erhält bei Fragen sehr schnell Antworten und bei Probleme wird einem wirklich gut weitergeholfen. Shein ist sehr großzügig. „Kunde ist König“ ist das Motto von Shein, würde ich sagen. Vielen Dank an Shein!!

title: Great products, poor customer service
content: I always loved shein but recently had really poor experience with the customer services. I got locked out of my account, the password rest wouldn’t work, regularly tried checking both my inbox and my junk mail, I tried a variety of web browsers and the app for this reset and nothing. I tried daily to talk to someone on the customer support and even though it was within their ‘opening times’ was offline. Every day. For a week! I tried messaging multiple of the Instagram accounts and got told to email them, who then after waiting, replied telling me to talk to the customer services that oh yeah once again offline. There was no where I could report anything and was chasing my tail all over the place. Had stuff I wanted to order, an existing order to track and then also want to place some items for a return and couldn’t do any of it. Such a unnecessarily stressful situation that I had to keep chasing and there was no one there to help. Was like a robot was replying on Instagram as the response was barely relevant to what I had sent. Just all in all an awful experience. Eventually I got to talk to someone and they reset my password. But even that took an extra 24 hours to get sorted. Just felt really let down as always loved shopping with shein.

title: SHEIN
content:
I absolutely love this brand! I tend to order a lot at once because of the cheap prices and huge range of styles.

Other than that I have no complaints for this brand! I absolutely love it and regularly order a whole batch of new things 😂❤️

title: Shop is good, app is not
content: I love Shien for the wide variety of clothes and accessories for my size! Not many places have nice plus size clothing, most places sell plain and boring clothes that make me look like an old lady! But Shien actually caters for younger audiences and I love it! HOWEVER, since the app has been updated, I can’t change my profile picture! The photo part is now just a white circle! On top of this, Shien VIP is ridiculous, I’ve followed the rules and it took months for it to actually show! And contacting someone to actually talk to is stupid, I can’t find ANY way to speak to someone, just a stupid robot that doesn’t answer my questions. Shien needs a better contacting route, there’s no number, email or online chat to contact in case something is wrong or you need to ask a question that isn’t answered in Q&A’s! I spent hours the other day trying to find a way to contact anyone after my VIP status hadn’t changed in months and the robot repeatedly answered with wrong answers and wouldn’t put me through to anyone despite it saying live chat was available!! Just ridiculous. I am happy however with the payment options. There’s a good range of options with good payment schemes. It’s just such a shame contacting someone is so hard to do! It’s the only thing that puts me off alongside the VIP statuses taking forever to change. Needs sorting ASAP.

title: Favourite place to shop now
content:
Truth be told when I first saw the ad pop up on Facebook for shein (a very long time ago) I was hugely sceptical.
I’ve been stung in the past with ordering clothing that looked beautiful and ended up being bad quality.. however over the last maybe years and a half / 2 years I have ended up spending an absolute fortune and don’t regret a single purchase.
That’s not just on clothing for me but on my 3 daughters (8,6 and 5 months) as well and all the items have been hard wearing and beautiful.
The prices are fantastic.. great voucher offers given too.
My one and only peeve is that sizes start at xxs and yet there is only ever a handful of items in each category combined for that sizing.. I’m a petite 4 usually so xxs tends to be a better fit for me.. though luckily I can happily fit an XS too if I wear things looser. but it would be nice to see the sizing be a little more inclusive for smaller/petites.

title: Nicht zu empfehlen.
content:
Also das positive zuerst. Es sind alle Artikel angekommen. & die Qualität ist für den Preis in Ordnung.
ABER: Bis endlich mal alles bei mir war hatte es Ewigkeiten gedauert. Es gab keine Info wo sich das Paket befindet oder wann ich denn ungefähr damit rechnen kann. Bis ich es endlich mal in den Chat geschafft hatte um mich zu erkundigen hat es auch sehr lange gedauert. Dann wurde ich immer aus dem Chat geworfen, weil angeblich keine Rückmeldung von mir kam. Obwohl ich auf eine Antwort gewartet hattet. Soll ich alle 30 Sekunden nachfragen wann mir endlich mal geantwortet wird? Meine Fragen konnten dann zwar beantwortet werden trotzdem finde ich den Kundenservice mehr als schlecht. Nachdem mein Paket da war, hatte ich einige Sachen zurück geschickt. Die Retour dauert nur genau so ewig. Das ist besonders dann schön wenn man eine Rechnung über Klarna hat. Die warten ja auch auf das Geld. Die Antwort von Shein war, da muss ich mich selber drum kümmern. Danke dafür. Ihr bekommt nichts hin und ich hab dann auch noch den Ärger. Wirklich klasse. Montag wurde mir von Shein gesagt (natürlich nur nachdem ich mal gefragt hatte wo denn die retour abgeblieben ist. Nach fast 14 Tagen) das Paket wäre angekommen, dass Geld wird aber erst in 10 Tagen ausgeglichen. Komisch. Nachdem ich mich gestern (Dienstag. Nur ein Tag später also) an Klarna gewandt hatte kam heute die aktualisierte Rechnung. Ich würde nie wieder bei euch bestellen. Da hat man mehr Ärger als das alles wert ist.

title: Very, very slow.
content: I’ve ordered from here three times and each time have had the same experience and will likely not use them again. You can find some very good clothes for brilliant prices, but the time to wait is simply not worth it. You would think this is because it is shipped from China, but I don’t think this is the case. Around a week after submitting my order, there was still an option to cancel an item, so it’s very clear that it wasn’t even packaged yet. The tracking system is very confusing and seems poorly translated and even though I had express shipping, it took the same time (about 16 days) and there was no difference from normal shipping time. However, the staff are incredibly good. They will ALWAYS reply within 24 hours - I mostly received a response before 12 hours - and they were very helpful and understanding. The only issue is the shipping times and tracking systems, so if you want to order from them, I suggest you order at least 3 weeks in advance and don’t bother with tracking until it’s with your local mail holder and then use their own tracking system.
